note: Every normative rule in ADR 0001 maps to at least one probe. A 'static' probe is a shell command run from the repo root and passes on exit 0. A 'live' probe is a message sent through the real daemon delivery path and read back with tg_get_messages; its observation is recorded in live-evidence.json and re-validated here, so the runner checks the recorded observation rather than trusting a claim. A 'ci' probe reads a GitHub Actions conclusion. Run: python3 docs/adr/probes/run.py

probes.claim: a local image reference is claimed by the image family and rendered inline as a photo entry
probes.cmd: grep -qF 'pub(crate) fn is_supported_image' src/utils/image.rs && grep -qF '![{alt}](tg://photo?id={id}{title})' src/utils/image.rs

probes.claim: the image kind is decided by the head BYTES (PNG/JPEG/GIF87a/GIF89a/RIFF-WEBP/BMP signatures), not by the file extension
probes.cmd: grep -qF 'b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"' src/utils/image.rs && grep -qF 'b"\xff\xd8\xff"' src/utils/image.rs && grep -qF 'GIF89a' src/utils/image.rs && grep -qF 'WEBP' src/utils/image.rs

probes.claim: a local video reference is claimed by the video family via an ISO-BMFF box walk and rendered as a video entry
every other file kind gets a document media entry with a recorded ResolvedFileRef
probes.cmd: grep -qF 'pub const DOC_ID_PREFIX' src/utils/image.rs && grep -qF 'self.entries.push(ResolvedFileRef' src/utils/image.rs

claim: the .md exception is gone from the CONFIG and the CODE; the only surviving mentions are comments and the test that asserts its absence

probes.claim: with no rich path every kind still ships as its own detached bubble
a document reference is emitted in LINK syntax and never in image syntax
a photo and a video reference are emitted in image syntax, because that is what the client renders for a media block
the walk reads both markdown forms, so the form the author typed does not decide the route
a reference the media array cannot answer is neutralised before the send, never left to 400 the message
probes.cmd: grep -qF 'pub(crate) fn neutralize_orphan_photo_refs' src/channels/telegram/rich/mermaid.rs && grep -qF 'neutralize_orphan_photo_refs' src/channels/telegram/rich/api.rs

probes.claim: a media entry Telegram refuses costs that entry, not the whole rich plane
probes.cmd: grep -qF 'fn retry_rich_media_around_offender' src/channels/telegram/rich/api.rs && grep -qF 'fn is_media_entry_rejection' src/channels/telegram/rich/api.rs

probes.claim: the final leg suppresses itself when a recorded intermediate already carries the same reply, comparing reference spelling rather than whitespace
probes.cmd: grep -qF 'normalize_reference_spelling' src/channels/telegram/delivery.rs && grep -qF 'pub(crate) fn normalize_reference_spelling' src/channels/telegram/intermediates.rs

probes.claim: a local document sent through the daemon is stored as a link-form tg://document reference and lands as one bubble
a remote URL written in link syntax stays a hyperlink: no fetch, no unsupported-format trailer
an unbracketed path in prose is claimed by no family and stays inert text
a REMOTE image reference written in embed syntax is fetched and arrives as a photo
a reply carrying documents lands as one bubble, with no degraded HTML copy beside it
a LOCAL image reference written in embed syntax is attached as a photo; the measured failure is that its bytes are refused and the picture never arrives
the tree that carries every rule above compiles and passes its tests on the CI gate
